appIds.title: App Store app IDs
appIds.description: Numeric App Store IDs, e.g. "284882215". Find it in the app's App Store URL: apps.apple.com/us/app/name/id284882215 -> "284882215". One lookup is billed per app.

country.title: Storefront country
country.description: Two-letter App Store storefront country code (e.g. "us", "gb", "jp"). Reviews are storefront-specific.

daysBack.title: Days back
daysBack.description: Only return reviews posted within this many days of today.

maxResultsPerApp.title: Max reviews per app
maxResultsPerApp.description: Maximum number of reviews to return per app, most recent first.
